comment: The distinction between the Product Registry and Product Catalogue Management Tool is useful, but the placement states that countries should implement the registry first. Some countries may already have operational catalogues or regulatory product databases that can be adapted as the authoritative registry.

public.text: The distinction between the Product Registry and Product Catalogue Management Tool is useful, but the placement states that countries should implement the registry first. Some countries may already have operational catalogues or regulatory product databases that can be adapted as the authoritative registry.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace the fixed sequence with a capability-based assessment. Countries should identify and strengthen an existing authoritative source where suitable rather than necessarily deploying a new registry first.
